decisions.ink: The formula number and equation occupy a separate baseline. Inserting a space between the numeral subscript 1 and M changes tokenizer segmentation but not the written index or object. The upper circular retracing and lower long loop still admit g/G, so the blind unqualified g and function-style M opening parenthesis are not imposed. The right closing curve is separate and clear. The two cancellation/superscript nesting orders are equivalent. The curved opening beside et and the separate closing curve at the right edge are exposed. Auto-matiq includes a long q descender, followed by a small high t-like mark. No complete m/e/n/t sequence is exposed after q, so automatiquement is not supplied as an alternative completion. The short shaft has a downward terminal return without a complete upper wing. Both Pi symbols lack the subscript 1 that is clearly present in the display above.
